  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: Model or isolation failures (isolation_failed, invalid_model_config, verdict_secret_rejected) blank the output and produce a counted invalid_verdict marker, so they are indistinguishable from a refused answer.
  WHY: Two provider or sandbox outages reach INVALID_VERDICT_PARK_AFTER=2 and park or close items the model never answered; severity disagreement: minimax rated NIT, sonnet rated MAJOR (highest used).
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:1611-1619 | severity=major | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The marker-post retry loop re-POSTs the same comment after any nonzero gh api result without checking whether GitHub already created it.
  WHY: A lost response after a successful create yields a duplicate marker that invalid_verdict_streak counts twice; severity disagreement: sonnet rated NIT, qwen rated NIT (arguing the arithmetic still parks after two refusals), others rated MAJOR (highest used).
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:1620-1623 | severity=nit | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The WARNING after a failed invalid_verdict_record write has no once-per-condition dedup state.
  WHY: A persistent comment-write failure sends a WARNING on every judge retry, contrary to the agents.md once-per-condition alert guidance.
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:40-64,1618 | severity=nit | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: UNBLOCK_INVALID_RECORD_RETRY_SECS is missing from the script header's optional-env list.
  WHY: It is the only UNBLOCK_* switch not self-documented there; the default of 5 is set inline.

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:1948-1951,1960-1963,2028-2031,1595-1623 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: A failed model or isolation run is not told apart from a refused answer. The output is blanked, verdict_raw.json becomes {}, and a counted invalid_verdict marker is posted.
  WHY: invalid_verdict_streak counts these markers and INVALID_VERDICT_PARK_AFTER is 2, so a provider or sandbox outage lasting two scan retries parks every blocked item the scan reaches. verdict_secret_rejected would also be counted as a refusal.
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:1611-1619 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The second attempt posts the same comment whenever the first gh api returns non-zero, without checking whether GitHub already created it.
  WHY: A lost response after a successful write adds a second identical marker, so one refusal reads as two and the item is parked prematurely.
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:1620-1623 | severity=NIT | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The WARNING after op=invalid_verdict_record outcome=failed has no once-per-condition state.
  WHY: Persistent write failure sends a WARNING on every judge run (default every 6 hours), contrary to the agents.md guidance.
- TASK_GAP: changelog.d/7901-blocked-item-alerts.md | severity=NIT | confidence=2
  Requirement: Docs deliverable, `agents.d/` and `changelog.d/` fragments; the autofix round added a marker retry, an op=invalid_verdict_record log line and a WARNING.
  Evidence of absence: The changelog fragment does not mention them, while agents.d/7901-blocked-item-alerts.md covers all three.
- HARDENING: scripts/unblock_judge.sh:1948-1963 | Set a flag in unblock_ask_model on isolation failure or verdict_secret_rejected and skip the counted marker (about 5 lines).
- HARDENING: scripts/unblock_judge.sh:1611-1619 | Re-read the comments before the second attempt, or drop the retry (about 6 lines).
- HARDENING: scripts/unblock_judge.sh:1618 | Clamp UNBLOCK_INVALID_RECORD_RETRY_SECS to a number between 0 and 60 before sleep (about 2 lines).
- HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 2
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

  PROBLEM: The marker post retry logic does not check whether the comment was already created on GitHub.
  WHY: A lost response after a successful create makes the second attempt a duplicate, which inflates invalid_verdict_streak and can terminalize the item as invalid_verdicts prematurely.
- HARDENING: scripts/unblock_judge.sh:1611-1619 | Read the issue comments for an existing marker before retrying (5-10 lines).

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:1595-1608,1914-1963,2028-2031 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: unblock_ask_model returns 0 with an empty verdict on isolation_failed, invalid_model_config and verdict-secret refusal, so an infrastructure failure feeds INVALID_VERDICT_PARK_AFTER like a refused answer.
  WHY: Two consecutive Docker, isolation or provider failures reach invalid_verdict_streak == 2, and the item is parked with a CRITICAL page or closed during an outage. The repo already treats rc 80 (Claude capacity) as a non-model failure.
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:1611-1619 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: A non-idempotent create is retried blindly with the identical body after any non-zero exit, and it bypasses gh_retry/gh_api_retry.
  WHY: A lost response creates a second matching marker. invalid_verdict_streak (scripts/unblock_ledger.py:743-757) counts each one, so decide (unblock_ledger.py:854-855) returns terminal invalid_verdicts on the next run and one refusal parks the item.
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:1620-1623 | severity=NIT | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The WARNING has no dedup state or condition marker.
  WHY: A persistent comment-write failure pages on every judge tick, and agents.md requires a once-per-condition alert for repeating paths.
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:40-64,1618 | severity=NIT | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: UNBLOCK_INVALID_RECORD_RETRY_SECS is missing from the script header's optional-env list and is not forwarded by unblock_judge.yml.
  WHY: It is discoverable only from the agents.md fragment. There is no runtime failure because the default is 5.
- TASK_GAP: changelog.d/7901-blocked-item-alerts.md | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  Requirement: PR docs ship `agents.d/` and `changelog.d/` fragments describing the behaviour, including the marker retry, the op=invalid_verdict_record log line and the extra WARNING.
  Evidence of absence: The 16-line changelog fragment has no reference to UNBLOCK_INVALID_RECORD_RETRY_SECS, op=invalid_verdict_record or the new WARNING; the last run updated agents.d only.
- HARDENING: scripts/unblock_judge.sh:1618 | Normalise the sleep value to a number and cap it at 60 (4 lines).
- HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:1611-1618 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The retry repeats the marker-creating POST after any nonzero result without checking whether GitHub created the comment.
  WHY: A lost response creates another matching marker, which invalid_verdict_streak counts separately (scripts/unblock_ledger.py:755-758), so the next judge run can park the item after one refusal.
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:1620-1622 | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The WARNING for failed refusal-marker writes has no deduplication.
  WHY: Each judge retry sends another WARNING while the endpoint keeps failing, contrary to the repo's once-per-condition alert guidance.
=== END FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===

- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:1611-1619 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The retry re-posts the refusal marker after any nonzero gh api result without checking whether GitHub already created the comment.
  WHY: By the reviewer's arithmetic the item still parks after two refusals either way, so the duplicate does not cause premature parking. The impact is an extra comment and a misleading streak count in the log.

  Requirement: The PR docs bullet ("Docs: `agents.d/` and `changelog.d/` fragments") and the autofix round's additions (marker retry with UNBLOCK_INVALID_RECORD_RETRY_SECS, op=invalid_verdict_record outcome=failed log line, WARNING page) should be reflected in the changelog.
  Evidence of absence: The "For contributors" paragraph does not mention the retry, the log line or the WARNING, which are shipped in scripts/unblock_judge.sh:1611-1623 and documented in agents.d/7901-blocked-item-alerts.md.
